MANAGED PARTNERSHIP

How Our Partnership & Technology Works

Cael Hub provides the complete technology, server infrastructure, and ongoing maintenance for your business so you can focus on serving your customers.

🏷️
100% YOUR BRAND

Can you use your own company name and logo?

Yes, complete brand personalization. Your mobile application is personalized under your own company name, logo, custom color palette, app icons, and branding facing your customers.

📱
ZERO UPFRONT FEES

Are there upfront software licensing or development fees?

Zero upfront software development fees. Gain access to a business application ready for deployment without traditional software licensing or custom build expenses under our partnership.

🔄
INCLUDED

Is ongoing software maintenance included?

Yes, continuous maintenance & updates. Enjoy ongoing updates, bug fixes, performance improvements, and eligible personalization handled by Cael Hub at no additional development fee.

☁️
MANAGED CLOUD

How are servers, hosting, and databases handled?

Fully managed technical infrastructure. We handle your application's servers, database administration, server hosting, and technical maintenance so you never have to manage IT operations.

💡
2% SERVICE SHARE

How does the 2% service share work?

Transparent transaction share. Cael Hub automatically receives an agreed 2% share of your business's collected service fee on each eligible transaction (e.g. if you collect a 15% service fee, Cael Hub's share is deducted automatically from that fee) to cover hosting, database management, software maintenance, and support.

✦ Your brand • Managed infrastructure & maintenance • Simple 2% service share
